summary: Iter36 — Section 33 Featured Providers Reel + Engagement Badges. Backend pytest 13/13 PASS for new test_iter36_featured_reel.py (schema, paid-plan filter, sort by tier+rating, cap=20, no _id leak, demo provider on plan=pro with referrals_credited>=1, 404 on unknown provider badges, referrer badge with count). Frontend Playwright: all critical testids verified — featured-reel-section, slider, see-all (→/search), upgrade-link (→/plans), reel-card-{id} for demo provider, plan badge ('✓ Plus' for pro), referrals badge ('2 traídos'), likes counter, like button click toggles ♡→♥, persists localStorage 'getamano_likes', optimistic counter goes 3→4, aria-pressed=true, spark style tag injected, anon toast 'Inicia sesión para sincronizar tus favoritos' appears. ProviderECard EngagementBadges container renders with badge-referrer pill (amber). Regression iter32/33/34/35 backend: 39 pass + 1 fail + 3 errors in single run, BUT all 4 errors/failure are caused by /api/auth/login 429 rate-limit (5/60s) when running suites back-to-back — known issue documented in iter35. Re-ran test_iter35_referrals.py alone after 70s sleep → 15/15 PASS confirming no actual regression.

minor.issue: Rate-limit (5/60s) causes 429 when running multiple module-scoped pytest files back-to-back. Same minor issue surfaced in iter35; recommend test-account allowlist or higher cap. Not an iter36 regression — iter35 suite passes 15/15 when run alone.

action_items: (Optional, repeated from iter35) Add data-testid='share-ecard-block' to ShareECardBlock root for stable selector — currently only locatable via heading text.
(Optional, repeated from iter35) Add test-account allowlist on /api/auth/login rate-limiter so back-to-back pytest suites don't trip 429.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/providers/featured-reel correctly merges active subscriptions + legacy provider_profiles.plan and dedupes via user_to_plan dict (line 1961 only writes if not present, so subscription wins over legacy — correct precedence).
Sort uses (PLAN_TIER, -rating, -reviews_count) which produces premium>pro>basic and high-rating first — matches spec.
Online detection uses ISO-string comparison on sessions.created_at which works because timestamps are stored as ISO 8601 with consistent timezone — verified by curl.
MongoDB _id is properly projected away (`{_id: 0}`) in all aggregations & finds — verified test_no_mongo_id_leaks passes.

_badges_for_provider correctly tiers referrer (1-2) vs top_referrer (3+) and chambero (5+) vs active_applicant (2-4); singular/plural for 'traíd@'/'traídos' matches the frontend pluralization in ReelCard.
FeaturedProvidersReel returns null when providers.length === 0 — verified the loading skeleton transitions properly and there's no empty section header.
Like button is anon-friendly: localStorage only when !user, server-side POST when signed in. The optimistic counter update + rollback on backend failure is the right pattern.
Spark/heart animation only fires on LIKE (not unlike) per spec — `if (!isLiked && likeBtnRef.current)` guard is correct.
Anon toast nudge gated by sessionStorage('reel_like_nudged') so it only shows once per session — matches spec.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all reel + engagement-badges testids verified + like interaction + anon nudge)
